62294.subject: Computer Studies
62294.question_text:
(a) Define the term operating system. (b) State two functions of an operating system. (c) List two types of: (i) application software (ii) translators

(d) You were asked as a school prefect to compile the personal data of final year students in your school. State two software that could be used to perform the task.
62294.explanation:
(a) An operating system is a software program that manages the hardware and software resources of a computer.

(b) Controlling input and output controlling program execution.

(C) (i) Standard application software e.g Word processing, Spreadsheet, Customized application software e g  payroll system, billing system. (ii) Compilers and Interpreters (d (1) Microsoft word (2) Microsoft Access

62295.subject: Computer Studies
62295.question_text:
(a) What is a computer file?

(b) State two features each of: (i) transaction file (ii) reference file.

(c) List two: (i) effects of file insecurity (ii) methods of securing files.
62295.explanation:
(a) Is a block of arbitrary information or resource tor Storing information which is available to a computer program and is usually base on some kind of durable storage.

(b)(i) (1) contains details of all transactions that may occur in the last period (2) once the data has been processed, it can be discarded

(3) contains temporary collection of data (4) the records may not be in any order at all. (ii) Stores data needed for reference purposes. It's fairly permanent in nature.

(c) (i) Data loss and Overwriting (ii) Data backup and Anti-virus.

62296.question_text: (a) Define the term system development cycle. (b) List four stages involved in system development cycle (c) State four qualities of a good program.

(a) Is a set of rules and sequential steps that define how a particular problem can be solved in a finite and ordered sequence

(b) (i) Input (ii) Output (ii) Effectiveness
